## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal deviated from its own learned baseline by more than the configured number of deviations. It did NOT cross a fixed number, so 'the value looks normal to me' is not a reason to close this.

Query:

```
avg(last_1h):anomalies(sum:acme.identity.privileged_actions{__SCOPE__} by {identity_provider}.as_rate(), 'agile', 4, direction='above') >= 1
```

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-security-telemetry`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-security-control` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `control_last_success`, `source_agent_state`, `related_signals`.

Attached to the alert automatically: last successful control run, agent state, related Cloud SIEM signals.
